title: Co-Pay Share by Fare Brand for Summit Miles Upgrades
content:
The cash co-pay of a cleared miles upgrade in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program is shared according to the fare brand of the upgraded ticket, as its record under the Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand charter shows it. The fare brand sets the co-pay share percent.

| Fare brand of the upgraded ticket | Co-pay share percent |
|---|---|
| Crestline Main Flexible | 50 percent |
| Crestline Main Plus | 75 percent |
| Any other fare brand | 100 percent |

**Definition.** The shared co-pay is the miles upgrade co-pay per segment of the tier the member holds, multiplied by the co-pay share percent.

**Hypothetical figures on a tier co-pay of 75 USD:** Crestline Main Flexible 37.50 USD; Crestline Main Plus 56.25 USD; Crestline Main Cabin or Crestline Premium Economy 75.00 USD. On a tier co-pay of 0 every shared co-pay is 0.
